render frames 0 through 131071

retain per-engine main and auxiliary finite, peak, RMS, DC, saturation, and non-silence metrics
conditions.purpose: Prove all 24 authenticated macro-voice engines execute through the adapter with finite bounded main and auxiliary output.

subcase zero-hit: running true with lane 1 hits 0 and otherwise active Trigger route for 8192 frames
subcase zero-amplitude: running true with lane 1 amplitude 0 and otherwise active Trigger route for 8192 frames
subcase zero-route: running true with active lane values and all 64 routes exactly zero for 8192 frames
conditions.purpose: Prove the four declared suppression paths produce exact zero PCM and no source trigger.

set all lane phases to zero and all non-Trigger route weights to zero
retain the same Trigger route and render frames 0 through 131071
conditions.purpose: Falsify the central hypothesis if removing phase and non-trigger routing fails to change both the canonical trace and PCM from PAMP_MATRIX.

A lane boundary and accepted trigger occur before source rendering for that quantum. Outer host blocks only copy persistent quantum carry and never realign scheduler, random, source, or snapshot state.
